vehicle_retirement_consistent.name: vehicle_retirement_consistent
vehicle_retirement_consistent.value: ("vehicle"."lifecycle" = 'retired' and "vehicle"."retired_at" is not null) or ("vehicle"."lifecycle" <> 'retired' and "vehicle"."retired_at" is null)

trip_revenue_nonnegative.name: trip_revenue_nonnegative
trip_revenue_nonnegative.value: ("trip"."quoted_revenue_minor" is null or "trip"."quoted_revenue_minor" >= 0) and ("trip"."final_revenue_minor" is null or "trip"."final_revenue_minor" >= 0)

trip_assignment_required_check.name: trip_assignment_required_check
trip_assignment_required_check.value: "trip"."status" in ('draft', 'cancelled') or ("trip"."vehicle_id" is not null and "trip"."driver_id" is not null)

trip_actual_state_check.name: trip_actual_state_check
trip_actual_state_check.value:
("trip"."status" in ('draft', 'dispatched', 'cancelled') and "trip"."actual_start_at" is null and "trip"."actual_end_at" is null and "trip"."start_odometer_km" is null and "trip"."end_odometer_km" is null)
        or ("trip"."status" = 'in_progress' and "trip"."actual_start_at" is not null and "trip"."actual_end_at" is null and "trip"."start_odometer_km" is not null and "trip"."end_odometer_km" is null)
        or ("trip"."status" = 'completed' and "trip"."actual_start_at" is not null and "trip"."actual_end_at" is not null and "trip"."start_odometer_km" is not null and "trip"."end_odometer_km" is not null)

trip_odometer_check.name: trip_odometer_check
trip_odometer_check.value: ("trip"."start_odometer_km" is null or "trip"."start_odometer_km" >= 0) and ("trip"."end_odometer_km" is null or "trip"."end_odometer_km" >= "trip"."start_odometer_km")

trip_cancellation_reason_check.name: trip_cancellation_reason_check
trip_cancellation_reason_check.value: ("trip"."status" = 'cancelled' and nullif(trim("trip"."cancellation_reason"), '') is not null) or ("trip"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "trip"."cancellation_reason" is null)

expense_maintenance_link_check.name: expense_maintenance_link_check
expense_maintenance_link_check.value: ("expense"."kind" = 'maintenance' and "expense"."maintenance_order_id" is not null) or ("expense"."kind" <> 'maintenance' and "expense"."maintenance_order_id" is null)

maintenance_order_state_check.name: maintenance_order_state_check
maintenance_order_state_check.value:
("maintenance_order"."status" = 'scheduled' and "maintenance_order"."started_at" is null and "maintenance_order"."completed_at" is null and "maintenance_order"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("maintenance_order"."status" = 'in_progress' and "maintenance_order"."started_at" is not null and "maintenance_order"."completed_at" is null and "maintenance_order"."cancelled_at" is null and "maintenance_order"."opening_odometer_km" is not null)
        or ("maintenance_order"."status" = 'completed' and "maintenance_order"."started_at" is not null and "maintenance_order"."completed_at" is not null and "maintenance_order"."cancelled_at" is null and "maintenance_order"."opening_odometer_km" is not null and "maintenance_order"."closing_odometer_km" is not null)
        or ("maintenance_order"."status" = 'cancelled' and "maintenance_order"."completed_at" is null and "maintenance_order"."cancelled_at" is not null)

maintenance_order_dates_check.name: maintenance_order_dates_check
maintenance_order_dates_check.value: ("maintenance_order"."completed_at" is null or "maintenance_order"."completed_at" >= "maintenance_order"."started_at") and ("maintenance_order"."cancelled_at" is null or "maintenance_order"."cancelled_at" >= coalesce("maintenance_order"."started_at", "maintenance_order"."scheduled_at"))

maintenance_order_odometer_check.name: maintenance_order_odometer_check
maintenance_order_odometer_check.value: ("maintenance_order"."opening_odometer_km" is null or "maintenance_order"."opening_odometer_km" >= 0) and ("maintenance_order"."closing_odometer_km" is null or "maintenance_order"."closing_odometer_km" >= "maintenance_order"."opening_odometer_km")

maintenance_order_cancellation_reason_ch.name: maintenance_order_cancellation_reason_check
maintenance_order_cancellation_reason_ch.value: ("maintenance_order"."status" = 'cancelled' and nullif(trim("maintenance_order"."cancellation_reason"), '') is not null) or ("maintenance_order"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "maintenance_order"."cancellation_reason" is null)
